vo: Imagine you had one thousand dollars in twenty fifteen. Put it in gold, and you would barely double it. The S and P five hundred? A solid three times. Apple would make you rich. But Tesla, and then Nvidia, would have turned that thousand dollars into a small fortune. The difference between these choices is staggering. Which one did you pick? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
